title: Retry storms during the staging outage
body: During the staging outage all workers retried at the same moment and overwhelmed the database. We need the wait to grow after each failure.

title: Make the retry count configurable
body: Users should be able to choose how many tries they want.

title: Add jitter to retries?
body: How about adding a small random delay so clients do not retry at the same moment?

title: Health checks flapping
body: Health checks keep flapping during deploys. The retry may be making it worse.
